question: The Malabar Coast is located in which of the following States of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Malabar Coast is located in the state of Kerala and parts of Karnataka, India.**
 
• It is a** long, narrow coastline that runs along the southwestern shore of the Indian subcontinent. **
 
• **The Malabar Coast is located on the Arabian Sea. **
 
• It stretches from the southern part of Goa to Kanyakumari in the south. 
 
• The Malabar Coast is** known for its many lagoons, which are used for fishing and inland navigation**
